title: Contract Signing, First Due Date and Funding — Deal Desk Guideline
content:
A Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts contract is signed together with the purchase agreement of the financed order. Signing turns the approval active and funds the contract.

## Signing conditions

1. **Within approval validity.** The contract is signed no later than the last day of the approval validity counted from the decision date. Approval validity is counted in calendar days with the decision date as day 0 and ends at the end of the approval expiration date. The decision date on the approval record is the anchor; a signing on the expiration date itself is within validity.
2. **Stipulations verified.** The contract is signed only when the approval's stipulations are verified, as the approval record shows.

## Schedule set at signing

- The first due date falls between the tier's first payment minimum and maximum days after the contract date, on the chosen due day (1 to 28).
- The maturity date is the first due date plus term months minus one month.

## Funding

Funding books the amount financed as principal on the contract date and pays the proceeds to the purchase order. Funding is booked only on a contract whose status is active.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Decision date | Approval validity | Last day of validity | Signing date | Within validity? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-02 | 30 days | 2026-04-01 | 2026-04-01 | yes, the expiration date itself |
| 2026-03-02 | 30 days | 2026-04-01 | 2026-04-02 | no, one day after |
| 2026-03-02 | 14 days | 2026-03-16 | 2026-03-16 | yes |
| 2026-03-02 | 14 days | 2026-03-16 | 2026-03-17 | no |

## Hypothetical schedule

A 60-month contract with a first due date of 2026-05-15 has a maturity date of 2031-04-15: the first due date plus 60 months is 2031-05-15, and one month less is 2031-04-15.
